title: Width of a statement
statement: The width of a statement is defined recursively. It is $0$ for a skip; for an assignment it is the maximum of the assigned variable's index plus one and the expression width; for a store it is the maximum of the address and value expression widths; for a sequence it is the maximum of the two statement widths; for a conditional it is the maximum of the condition width and both branch widths; and for a loop it is the maximum of the condition and body widths. For a procedure call, it is the maximum of the destination variable's index plus one, the number of arguments, and the maximum width of the argument expressions (with maximum $0$ when there are no arguments).
